test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When was the Fit India movement launched to encourage Indians to include fitness activities and sports in their daily lives to pave the way for a healthy and fit lifestyle?
solution:
The correct answer is__** August 2019.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fit India Movement was launched by Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi at Indira Gandhi Stadium in New Delhi on 29 August 2019 on the occasion of National Sports Day.
 
• It is a Nation Wide Movement in India to motivates the people of India to remain Healthy and Fit by including Sports activities and Physical Activities in their daily lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fit India was founded in 1993 by Shri Suparno Satpathy and incorporated as a company in 2000.
 
• Fit India Movement is a nationwide movement in India that encourages people to remain healthy and fit by including physical and sports activities in their daily lives.
